Question: Suppose \(a,\) \(b,\) \(c\) are positive integers such that \[a + b + c = 23\] and \[ \begin{aligned} &\gcd(a, b) + \gcd(b, c) \\ &\quad {}+ \gcd(c, a) = 9. \end{aligned} \] What is the sum of all possible distinct values of \(a^2 + b^2 + c^2?\)
